failure_mode: A canonical TOKEN_VAZIO approval decision declares APPROVED_CLOSED while its evidence package references a commit SHA that GitHub reports does not exist in rafaelmeloreisnovo/Mapa.

source_evidence.observation: TOKEN_VAZIO_INVARIANTS_CI_BINDING_MISSING is marked APPROVED_CLOSED with evidence commit_sha 3a2c8f18eef4f5a9b5c8d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f9a0.
The same TOKEN_VAZIO remains PRESERVED_IN_DOCUMENTATION, creating registry/decision divergence.

not_proven: The invariant CI implementation itself is absent or defective.
An incorrect external claim was consumed downstream.
The historical decision must be deleted.
proven_scoped: The cited commit SHA cannot currently validate the closure evidence package.
The registry and approval-decision states diverge.

append_only_rule: Do not delete or rewrite the historical decision. Add a superseding verification receipt that references the historical record and a real immutable evidence chain.

impact_radius.transmitted_effect: Invalid closure provenance can cause later automation or reviewers to inherit a CLOSED state without reconstructible evidence.
impact_radius.false_positive_cost: Re-running invariant evidence collection and preserving an additional receipt.
impact_radius.false_negative_cost: Silent overpromotion of governance state and contamination of downstream receipts.

detective: validate every commit/ref/artifact pointer in approval decisions
cross-check canonical registry against decision ledger
preventive: add referential-integrity gate for receipt pointers before closure
precautionary: reopen assurance until immutable evidence resolves
adaptive: treat receipt/decision ledgers as lifecycle-managed components
corrective: emit superseding receipt with real commit/run/job/artifact identities
maintenance: periodically reconcile registry, decisions, receipts and live refs
incident_investigation: preserve historical record and establish whether the invalid SHA was placeholder, transcription error, generated value or stale pointer
safety_assurance: verify re-closed state survives independent reconstruction from repository evidence

F_ok: invalid SHA detected before using it as new evidence in this cycle
F_gap: real immutable closure evidence package for invariant CI binding
referential-integrity gate for all approval receipts
F_next: resolve actual implementing commit and exact workflow run
append superseding closure or preservation decision
F_esquecido: a decision ledger is not itself proof
syntactically valid SHA text is not evidence that a commit exists
